home.title: Loot your neighbours!
home.intro: In Looters you found a State from your favourite municipality and conquer the whole map.

map.label: Map of {{name}}
map.empty: The map will appear here once the municipal boundaries have been uploaded.
map.error: The map is not available right now.

matches.title: Matches in progress
matches.name: Match name

matches.error: The list of matches is not available right now.

demo.label: Demonstration of the game on the map
demo.note: This is a demonstration: no real match.

start.title: Choose a municipality
start.text: You enter a match by founding your State on a free municipality: it becomes your capital.

grow.title: Annex your neighbours
grow.text: Every turn you earn resources and can annex the free municipalities that border yours.

fight.title: Loot
fight.text: You attack other players' municipalities without knowing how many resources defend them. Whoever is attacked chooses to defend or to give up.

win.title: Conquer the map
win.text: Whoever loses their capital falls. The last State standing wins, or the richest at the deadline.

auth.usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits and underscore.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

page.title: Enter Looters
page.intro: Sign in with your account or create one: a username and a password are enough.

sessions.revokeText: The user is signed out immediately and will have to sign in again.

geo.name: Name
geo.noAreas: No areas. Create one, for example "Italy", then upload the municipal boundaries to it.
geo.pickFolder: Choose an area or a folder to upload files.
geo.deleteText: The folders, files and municipalities it contains are deleted too. This cannot be undone.
geo.formats: KML or GeoJSON, with boundaries in WGS84 coordinates.
geo.noUploads: No files uploaded to this folder.
geo.deleteUploadText: The municipalities loaded from this file are deleted too. This cannot be undone.

failure.INVALID_FILE: The file cannot be read: it is not a valid KML or GeoJSON.
failure.NOT_FEATURE_COLLECTION: The file is not a collection of GeoJSON features (FeatureCollection).
failure.FILE_MISSING: The uploaded file is no longer available. Upload it again.
failure.FEATURE_PROBLEMS: Some features in the file are not valid. No municipalities were loaded.
failure.ALREADY_LOADED: These municipalities are already in this area:
failure.EMPTY_GEOMETRY: These municipalities have a boundary that cannot be used:
failure.INTERNAL: Processing failed because of an internal error.

problem.BAD_COORDINATES: the coordinates are not in WGS84 (longitude and latitude in degrees).
problem.RING_TOO_SHORT: the boundary has fewer than four points.
problem.DUPLICATE_CODE: the code is repeated in the file.

geo.isolated_one: {{count}} municipality with no neighbours (an island): connect it in "Neighbouring municipalities", otherwise it cannot be reached in a match.
geo.isolated_other: {{count}} municipalities with no neighbours (islands): connect them in "Neighbouring municipalities", otherwise they cannot be reached in a match.

adjacency.title: Neighbouring municipalities
adjacency.intro: Borders are calculated on upload. Search for a municipality to check its neighbours and add by hand those the geometry does not find, such as islands.
adjacency.isolatedIntro: These are islands or municipalities that touch no other: in a match they can be neither annexed nor attacked until you connect them to a neighbour. Choose one and add its neighbours.

errors.AREA_NAME_TAKEN: A folder with this name already exists here.
errors.AREA_IN_USE: A match uses this folder: it cannot be deleted.
errors.UPLOAD_IN_USE: A match uses these municipalities: the file cannot be deleted.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Only KML and GeoJSON files are accepted.
errors.ALREADY_ADJACENT: These two municipalities are already neighbours.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.

preview.title: Map
preview.hint: Tap a municipality to highlight its neighbours.

new.title: New match
new.intro: Choose where and when to play. You can open registrations straight away or save a draft and come back to it later.
new.guest: Sign in to create a match.

form.name: Name
form.rulesLocked: The rules can no longer be changed: registrations are open.
form.botsHint: Empires led by the game, which appear on free municipalities as the turns go by and play on their own: they annex, attack and defend like a player. This way a single player is enough for a match. How many and how often is set in the rules.

rules.lateJoin: Players can join after the match has started
rules.incomePerUnit: Income per turn: for each municipality
rules.surrenderRefundPct: Refund to the attacker on surrender (%)
rules.mergeCostTurns: Merge: cost per territory, in turns
rules.boardMessageIntervalSec: Seconds to wait between two messages from an empire
rules.botSpawnChancePct: Chance of a bot appearing each turn (%)

info.lateStart: The start time has passed but the match has not started: at least {{min}} players are needed. Whoever created it can set a new date.

owner.title: Match management
owner.draftIntro: Only you can see this draft. Once you open registrations, the map and rules can no longer be changed.

join.closed: Registrations for this match are closed.

empire.editLocked: Name, colour and emblem can no longer be changed: the match has started.
empire.withdrawText: Your empire is deleted and the starting municipality becomes free again. Until the match starts you can join again, even choosing another municipality.
empire.logoHint: An image in place of the emblem: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 200 KB at most. Everyone can see it.
empire.logoTooLarge: The image is over 200 KB: choose a smaller one.

attack.title: Attack on {{name}}
attack.fromHint: Choose one or more of your neighbouring municipalities, from the list or by tapping them on the map. More municipalities give more force, but each one pays a higher share.
attack.hidden: The enemy's resources are hidden: you cannot know how well defended this municipality is.
attack.reserved: The cost is paid straight away. If the enemy surrenders, half is returned to you.
attack.pick: Choose at least one municipality to attack from.

battles.title: Battles
battles.waiting: Waiting for the defender's response. With no response, the battle is fought at the end of the turn.
battles.answered: You have responded: waiting for the outcome.

attacker.SURRENDER: {{name}} surrendered: it is yours, and half the cost has been returned to you.
attacker.CANCELLED: The attack on {{name}} was cancelled: the cost has been returned to you.

alert.title: {{empire}} is attacking {{name}}
alert.intro: You have to choose before the end of the turn. If you do not respond, the municipality defends itself and you pay the defence cost.
alert.capital: This is your capital: if you lose it, your empire falls.
alert.defendHint: You pay {{count}} resources and the battle is fought straight away.
alert.surrenderHint: You give up the municipality with all its resources, without spending anything.
alert.resolving: Response sent. Waiting for the outcome…

end.spectator: Your empire has fallen. You stay in the match as a spectator.

map.canvas: Map: arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom

structures.title: Structures
structures.intro: Structures are paid for with the resources of the municipality they are placed on.

descriptions.BLOCK: For {{turns}} turns the municipality cannot be attacked, but it cannot attack either. When it expires, {{cooldown}} turns must pass before another block on the same municipality.
descriptions.SECOND_CAPITAL: If the main capital is conquered, your empire does not fall: this municipality becomes the new capital. You can only have one.

structures.whereHint: You can also tap one of your municipalities on the map.

structures.moveWait_other: You can move it in {{count}} turns.

merge.intro: Merge neighbouring municipalities into a single area: the resources are added together and the area attacks and defends as one territory. It cannot be split again.
merge.pickHint: Choose from the list or by tapping your municipalities on the map.

events.AREA_CREATED: {{empireName}} merged its territories into the area {{territoryName}}.
events.AREA_RENAMED: {{empireName}} renamed one of its areas: it is now {{territoryName}}.
events.ALLIANCE_LEFT: {{empireName}} announced it is leaving its alliance.
events.MATCH_FINISHED_TIE: The match ended in a tie. The winners are {{winnerName}}.
events.ALLIANCE_ENDING: {{empireName}} announced the end of its alliance with {{otherName}}.
events.ALLIANCE_ENDED: The alliance between {{empireName}} and {{otherName}} has ended.

alliance.title: Alliances
alliance.intro: Allies cannot attack each other, can see each other's resources and can exchange them. An alliance has at most {{max}} members and does not win: the winner is always a single empire.
alliance.noCandidates: No other empire to propose it to.
alliance.transferHint: You cannot send from or to a municipality in a battle: help is only preventive.
alliance.intro_one: An alliance is a pact between two empires: you cannot attack each other, you see each other's resources and you can exchange them. You can have only one ally. The allies of your ally are not your allies, and an alliance does not win: the winner is always one empire.
alliance.intro_other: An alliance is a pact between two empires: you cannot attack each other, you see each other's resources and you can exchange them. You can have up to {{count}} allies. The allies of your ally are not your allies, and an alliance does not win: the winner is always one empire.
alliance.full_one: You already have one ally, the maximum in this match.
alliance.full_other: You already have {{count}} allies, the maximum in this match.
alliance.endText: The end takes effect at the close of the next turn: until then you remain allies and cannot attack each other. In the meantime you can change your mind.
alliance.endingByYou: You announced the end: it takes effect at the end of turn {{turn}}.
alliance.endingByThem: {{name}} announced the end: it takes effect at the end of turn {{turn}}.
